summary: Wildlife cinematographer Sophie Darlington answers readers' questions about making the National Geographic documentary Lion, which followed one cub for four years as it grew up on the African savanna. She talks about breaking into wildlife filmmaking, how she gets close-up safari shots, and the hardest moments of the project.
title: A Filmmaker on What it Takes to Spend Four Years With Lions
